title: Reading Drill — Testing map legends — Preparing a second trial
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Testing map legends — Preparing a second trial
passages.body:
**A** In Brackenton, work on readers mistaking building boundaries for paths had already produced a small collection of marked copies. The cartography tutor used this material to plan a second trial. The first report contained several different figures, but for the second trial the group agreed to publish one main outcome: the number of navigation errors.

**B** The group kept a set of distinct line styles for the new trial, which was planned to run for six weeks. Volunteers were shown a sample record before starting. They were also asked to describe anything unusual in a separate note, so later readers could tell the difference between an ordinary value and one taken during a disruption.

**C** The trial design stated that prior knowledge of the area should be recorded even when everything else appeared normal. If this information was missing, the team would leave the field blank rather than infer an answer. It would publish a provisional finding and label it clearly if too few readings were available for a reliable result.
